title: Something Has Awakened
summary: In the aftermath of the courtyard battle, Ha-Jun escorts Min-Jae to safety as the Demon Hunter Bureau swarms the campus. Far away across dimensions in the Abyssal Realm, Demon King Malgath senses the Sovereign's pulse and mobilizes his armies—marking the grand completion of Arc 1.

panels.action: Wide aerial shot of Saint Mirren University quadrangle in smoking ruins; shattered cobblestones, light rain drizzling over the crater.
Ha-Jun reaches his hand down to help Min-Jae up from the wet grass, pulling his trembling friend to his feet.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Utho, Min-Jae. Yahan rukna theek nahi hai.

panels.action: Min-Jae adjusts his crooked glasses with trembling fingers, staring at Ha-Jun's composed silhouette in awe and fear.

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Yeh wahi Ha-Jun hai... jise kal sab maarte the...?

panels.action: Dozens of high-pitched police and tactical sirens echo across the stone buildings, flashing red and blue against the clouds.
Kuro's telepathic whisper: 'Humein turant nikalna hoga. Bureau ke log aa rahe hain. Insaano ki kanoon yahan sirf rukawat banegi.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Nikal yahan se! Bureau ke Hunters aa rahe hain!

panels.shot: walking side by side to exit
panels.action: Ha-Jun leads Min-Jae down a secluded hedge path behind the gymnasium away from the main gates.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Chal sakte ho?

panels.action: Ha-Jun looks back toward the smoke rising from the courtyard: 'Maine bas wahi kiya... jo zaroori tha.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Maine bas wahi kiya jo zaroori tha.

panels.action: A convoy of matte-black tactical SUVs with tinted windows and silver cross insignias screeches through the front gates.
Inside the mobile command van: High-tech holographic monitors illuminate tactical analysts tracking mana wavelengths.
Special Agent Kang-Doo (scarred face, trench coat, cold demeanor) leans over a 3D hologram of the courtyard crater.

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain
dialogue.text: Yeh mana frequency... yeh normal rift nahi hai.

panels.action: A technician points at the spiked waveform graph: 'Captain! Yeh wavelength... Sovereign-class hai!'

dialogue.text: Captain! Yeh Sovereign-class wavelength hai!

panels.action: Kang-Doo violently grinds his cigarette out into a metal tray, his teeth gritting in disbelief.

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain
dialogue.text: Sovereign-class? Wo bloodline saat saal pehle Tae-Jun ke sath khatam ho gayi thi!

panels.action: The screen shows thermal replay analysis: 'Kisi ne Rank-C Greater Hound ko sirf ek single punch se khatam kar diya.'

dialogue.text: Sirf ek punch se Rank-C beast khatam!

panels.action: Kang-Doo pulls out a crimson-stamped dossier labeled: [THE BLOOD REGISTRY — SUSPECT: HA-JUN KANG].

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain
dialogue.text: Poore campus ko seal karo. Ek ek student ka mana scan lo.

panels.action: Armored Hunter operatives in black combat suits and silver cross visors cordon off the courtyard with glowing barrier pylons.
On the security monitor, a grainy freeze-frame catches Ha-Jun's back disappearing into the shadows of the rear campus gate.

dialogue.text: Lekin shikari pahunche... tab tak wo jaa chuka tha.

panels.action: The frame dissolves into swirling black cosmic clouds beneath a massive, shattered blood-red celestial eclipse.
Panoramic establishing shot of the ancient Abyssal Kingdom: Obsidian spires and Gothic castles floating above bubbling oceans of purple magma.

dialogue.text: Insaani duniya se bohot door... Abyss ki gehraiyon mein.

panels.action: Inside a cavernous cathedral of black bone: Gigantic skeletal pillars support a vaulted ceiling draped in crimson banners.
Seated on a throne of crushed dragon skulls: Demon King Lord Malgath (18 feet tall, four muscular arms, horned obsidian armor, burning skull face).

dialogue.text: First Demon King — Lord Malgath.

panels.action: Malgath's massive spiked claw violently crushes the skull armrest into powder as his crimson eyes flare with shock.
Two 10-foot demon generals prostrate on the obsidian floor, trembling: 'H-Huzoor Malgath?! Aapki neend kisne todi?!'

dialogue.text: Huzoor Malgath! Kya gustakhi hui?!

panels.action: Malgath's voice reverberates like tectonic plates grinding: 'Wo seal... First Sovereign ki pehli seal toot chuki hai.'

dialogue.speaker: demon_king_malgath
dialogue.text: First Sovereign ki pehli seal toot chuki hai.

panels.action: Extreme close-up on Malgath's flaming eyes: 'Uska khoon... insaano ki dharti par jaag utha hai.'

dialogue.speaker: demon_king_malgath
dialogue.text: Uska khoon... insaano ke jahan mein jaag utha hai.

panels.action: Malgath rises to his full 18-foot height, drawing a colossal serrated greatsword wrapped in glowing black sealing chains.
Malgath roars out his decree: 'Teeno Demon Lords ko jagao! Dharti ke darwaze khol do! Us ladke ka dil mujhe laakar do!!'

dialogue.speaker: demon_king_malgath
dialogue.text: TEENO LORDS KO JAGAO! USKA DIL MUJHE LAA KAR DO!!

panels.action: Vast sweeping shot: Tens of thousands of armored demonic beasts raise spiked halberds and roar under twin red moons.
Triptych split-screen: Left: Hunter Bureau mobilizing SWAT squads. Right: Demon King Malgath raising his sword. Center: Ha-Jun walking calmly in rain.

dialogue.text: Dono dunyaon ne apna agla shikar chun liya tha.

panels.action: Golden-purple system window appears: [ARC 1: THE CURSED FEATHER — COMPLETED] | [SYNCHRONIZATION: 10.0%] | [NEW TITLE: HEIR OF THE ABYSS].

dialogue.text: [ARC 1 COMPLETED] [SYNCHRONIZATION: 10.0%] [TITLE: HEIR OF THE ABYSS]

panels.action: Epic Arc 1 finale spread: Ha-Jun stands on an overpass overlooking the sparkling night city, Kuro perched on his shoulder, eyes burning violet: 'Aane do poori duniya ko. Main tayar hoon.'
panels.mood: legend is born, grand arc finale

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Aane do poori duniya ko. Main tayar hoon.
